label: Google Sheets: On New Row
description: Fires once per row added to a Google Sheets tab, polling on an interval. Starts from the sheet's end at activation (old rows never replay) and keeps its position across restarts.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: The picker grant covers the file it picked.

inputs.name: spreadsheet
inputs.label: Spreadsheet
inputs.placeholder: Pick one, or paste its share link

inputs.name: tab
inputs.label: Tab
inputs.placeholder: Pick a tab, or paste a link with #gid=
inputs.description: The tab to use. Empty: the first tab, whatever its id.

inputs.name: intervalSecs
inputs.label: Check every (seconds)
inputs.description: How often the sheet is checked.

inputs.name: hasHeader
inputs.label: First row is a header
inputs.description: Needed to order an object row's columns.

outputs.name: row
outputs.description: Keyed by the header (c0, c1, ... without one).
